target_customer: Businesses doing sales and marketing outreach
problem: Sales and marketing teams spend heavy effort on outbound calls and voice outreach that could be automated.
business_model: SaaS platform of conversational AI voicebots

founders.name: Ricardo Garcia-Amaya
previous_startups: Earlier B2B AI venture backed by $10M VC (per own bio)
founders.background_notes: Press also names Jessica Taggart as co-founder; not on YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Voice bots over telephony in 2015 needed speech recognition and dialog handling; the company later claimed a SaaS launch in Feb 2019, suggesting a long build.

defensibility.rationale: Depended on third-party speech tech; no proprietary moat described.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The 2019 article cites Amazon Alexa for Business as an emerging voice solution; no acquisition found.

market_need_then: Not evidenced from sources dated 2015. In 2019 the company claimed 700+ customers after its SaaS launch.
outcome_analysis: VOIQ, a 2014 company, raised a 2 million dollar round in November 2019 bringing its stated total to 5 million, claiming 700 customers after a February 2019 platform launch. The directory lists it as inactive but no shutdown reason or date was found, and databases disagree on total funding, so the cause of the stall is unknown.
notes: Total raised conflicts: article says $5M, CB Insights $2.5M, ZoomInfo $10M, Wellfound $14M. Pre-2019 rounds not itemized. Directory status Inactive but no shutdown source; exit unknown. A 2026 Japanese company VOIQ appears unrelated/unconfirmed.
